name: Ham, Zucchini, Carrot & Bell Pepper Skillet over Parmesan Polenta

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice polenta; place in a large pot along with broth, salt, and pepper. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (510 g) tubes polenta, pre-cooked
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the broth is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Using a potato masher, mash the polenta until smooth; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until heated through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; small dice. Place in a large bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and small dice zucchini. Add to the bowl with the bell peppers.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Add to the bowl along with the carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice ham. Add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, ham, and spices to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies soften and ham is warmed through, 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add Parmesan to the pot with the polenta and stir to combine.
To serve, divide polenta between plates or bowls; top with ham and veggie skillet. Enjoy!
